decision: Hermitianizing each existing BGCE483-484 source-word LCU unitary with one BGCE487 encoded signal qubit, then multiplying by the reflection about its success subspace, generates the exact Chebyshev walk required by BGCE490. No square-root-defect or spectral-READ_H primitive is needed.
construction: For success block A=A^dagger of U_A, define U_tilde=[[0,U_A],[U_A^dagger,0]], E=|+> tensor |PREP-success>, S=2EE^dagger-I and W=S U_tilde. Then E^dagger W^k E=T_k(A).
source_local_operations: BGCE484 source-counted PREP and typed source-word SELECT, source dagger/reversal, BGCE487 signal-qubit X/phase control, and a typed success-address reflection.
claim_ceiling: The exact low-normalization walk is compiled from the existing typed finite-list source-word controller, dagger and one typed success-address mark. The enlarged coherent controller and address mark are not derived from bare adjacent-Braid relations alone. Hardware errors, seconds calibration, continuum/QFT completion and empirical confirmation remain open.
